# Import identity cache recovery: independent scoped review

Verdict: **PASS for the exact 18 generated cache files in the companion JSON**, subject to Root's immediate at-action hash/process/Source guards. No blocking finding. No candidate was removed by this reviewer.

The two completed a418 test ELFs match their exact recorded bytes, SHA-256, inode/device, single link, mtime and allocated blocks. The normal fresh compiler receipts bind the tooling ELF to the actual 291 passing tooling tests and the UI ELF to 125 passing UI tests with one unchanged baseline ignore. The raw logs independently reproduce those counts. Those completed historical executions remain preserved; retiring their generated binaries does not delete or alter tests.

The other 16 candidates are exactly cgu.00 through cgu.15 from `android_tools-7334319486a8ebb2.android_tools.2180e8a756bf797d-cgu.*.rcgu.o`, individually named in the JSON. Every candidate is a regular ELF object with the exact recorded hash/inode/size/mtime/single-link binding. All 16 mtimes lie strictly inside the current failed attempt's before/after source-snapshot window. Their exact failed lib-test output prefix, new codegen naming, contained mtimes and exclusive owner runtime lease associate them with that interrupted compile. This is not successful current test evidence. The preserved 7e3 Cargo attempt exited 101 with ENOSPC while compiling the lib test; the raw log has no test-result line and grants zero current test credit. The raw log SHA-256 is `2a72471d299cf90d0a486aec435d49f4e5b6ff3cd66167fd4585d77295c413e1`.

All 18 files total 1,060,117,152 logical bytes and 1,055,301,632 allocated bytes. Those are scoped file estimates, not a guaranteed free-space or peak-build result. Root must record actual capacity improvement after exact-name unlink operations. There is no approval for additional cache paths or glob/recursive cleanup.

I also audited the already-completed public-Rlib deduplication. The original public alias and deps files had distinct single-link inodes and identical 315,735,670-byte content, SHA-256 `9c8c3235cac1fcfc10832e8af791487865164786533fb45afecac2440d0be570`. Both current paths now remain regular files with that same content and mode, sharing retained deps inode 1051264 with nlink 2. The preserved execution receipt records a 243,810,304-byte observed free-space increase. This establishes byte-preserving deduplication provenance and grants no fresh current-Source library/test/product credit.

Live UID0 dockerd 198 and containerd 249 deny cwd/executable/FD inspection, so their recorded limitations remain explicit and there is no claim of whole-system FD absence. No process was signaled.
